title: Pathetic trash, buy a electric one!
text: Pathetic trash, buy a electric one!. Don’t waste your money on this trash, it says Takes thirty minutes but we did fifty and it was still liquid, we had to use five towels to clean up all the water that leaked. We had to fill up ice and salt over and over again! It was so hard to open and it was so cold my finger went numb, and it leaked like crazy no matter how hard you close it. Fun concept but it still doesn’t work, we returned ours and got an electric one.

product_metadata.title: Yaylabs Softshell Ice Cream Ball
features: Ice Cream Maker Ball: Soft-sided ice cream ball maker produces approximately 1 pint of home-made ice cream with about 20 minutes of active play
Easy-To-Make Treat: Simply add cream, sugar and flavorings to one end of this homemade ice cream maker and add ice and rock salt to the other
Designed For Convenience: Small ice cream maker features built-in, easy-open handles with wide openings for adding ingredients and scooping out ice cream
Safe, Easy-To-Clean Design: The perfect ice cream maker for kids and adults, our ball is made from food-safe materials that are easy to clean and dishwasher safe
Includes: Our ice cream makers come with a Pure & Simple recipe booklet; Measures approximately 8.5 inches in diameter
